headerDisplay: Control Samsung OCF appliances locally (no Samsung cloud). Enter each appliance's LAN IP and its DTLS secure port. See the README for finding the port and the honest coverage/limitations notes.
footerDisplay: Reads are mapped from real appliance data; **writes are not yet verified against physical hardware** — see README.

pollIntervalMs.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.description: How often to re-read the appliance's full state.

port.title: DTLS secure port (optional)
port.description: The appliance's OCF secure (coaps) UDP port. Optional: if omitted, discovered from the appliance's plaintext /oic/res. It varies per unit and after a power cycle.

uuid.title: Client UUID (advanced)
uuid.description: Override the authorizing certificate UUID. Leave blank to use the standard one.

allowRemoteOffWrites.title: Allow writes when remote control is off
allowRemoteOffWrites.description: By default a write is refused when the appliance reports remote control off (it would be ignored). Enable only if you confirm yours accepts it.

observeHrefs.title: OBSERVE hrefs (advanced)
observeHrefs.description: Resource hrefs to subscribe to for push updates, e.g. /power/vs/0.

optionalModes.title: AC optional modes (advanced)
optionalModes.description: Air-conditioner convenient modes to expose as switches, e.g. Sleep, Quiet, Speed, WindFree. Must match the device's supported modes.
